# GOOGL close for 2026-09-12: research as of 2026-08-22

**Key point:** 2026-09-12 is a Saturday, so the question resolves to the **Friday 2026-09-11 close**. That is 14 trading days after the last close before the cutoff (Aug 21). I could not load any pages directly (the proxy refused every fetch), so all figures come from search-result summaries. I ignored any material dated after 2026-08-22.

## 1. Resolution source
- The resolution source is the GOOGL daily close on Yahoo Finance. I could not open Yahoo's history page, so I used StockAnalysis's GOOGL history table instead.
- 2026-08-20: GOOGL closed at $340.67. [StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/googl/history/)
- 2026-08-21: GOOGL closed at **$344.82**, up 1.22% (open 342.58, high 346.20, low 340.40, volume about 20.8M). The dividend-adjusted close was 344.60. Yahoo's unadjusted "Close" column should match 344.82. [StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/googl/history/)
- Don't confuse this with GOOG (Class C), which closed at $341.75 on Aug 21. [StockAnalysis GOOG](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/goog/history/)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question. The price is about $345, near the middle of the 250 to 450 range.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-19: Alphabet said it will present at the Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference, which is usually held in early to mid September. [Alphabet IR](https://abc.xyz/investor/news/default.aspx)
- 2026-08-15: Berkshire Hathaway's 13F filing showed it added about $17B to its Alphabet stake (holdings as of June 30). [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/15/berkshire-adds-17-billion-to-alphabet-stake.html)
- 2026-08-11: The Motley Fool ran "Huge News for Alphabet Stock Investors." I could not read the details. [Fool](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/11/huge-news-for-alphabet-stock-investors/)
- 2026-08-05: Alphabet overhauled its AI leadership. Demis Hassabis moved to chief scientist and DeepMind chair. Jeff Dean, Sanjay Ghemawat, Oriol Vinyals and Quoc Le left to start Discovery Loop. The flagship Gemini model, planned for June, was still unreleased. Shares fell about 4%. [BusinessDay](https://www.businessday.co.za/world/international-companies/2026-08-05-alphabet-shakes-up-ai-leadership-as-deepmind-revamp-gathers-pace/), [CNBC video](https://www.cnbc.com/video/2026/08/05/alphabet-shares-fall-after-major-shakeup-at-googles-ai-unit.html)
- 2026-08-05: 24/7 Wall St. said the stock was still up 16% in 2026. [24/7 Wall St.](https://247wallst.com/investing/2026/08/05/alphabet-is-still-up-16-in-2026-what-will-it-take-to-get-googl-stock-above-400/)
- 2026-08-03: GOOGL closed up 4.88% at $373.51. Drivers were Morgan Stanley defending the outlook, a broad rally after Trump called off planned strikes on Iran, and an expanded Oracle cloud deal. [Kalkine](https://kalkine.com/news/technology/why-is-alphabet-stock-surging-today), [Fool](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/03/why-alphabet-stock-popped-today/)
- 2026-07-22/23: Q2 results came in. Revenue was about $119.8B (up 24%) and Cloud grew 82%. Adjusted EPS of about $2.85 was slightly below consensus. Alphabet raised its 2026 capex guide; one source says up to about $205B, but sources conflict on that figure. Shares fell about 4% after hours to about $327 and were down roughly 7% the next session. [MarketBeat](https://www.marketbeat.com/articles/alphabet-crushed-earnings-but-one-number-spooked-the-market/), [KuCoin](https://www.kucoin.com/news/flash/alphabet-raises-full-year-capital-expenditure-forecast-shares-drop-4-after-hours)
- Low-quality reports also mention negative Q2 free cash flow, much higher debt, a suspended buyback and about $25B of new borrowing. These are unverified. [Vantage](https://www.vantagemarkets.com/en/academy/alphabet-stock-outlook/)

## 4. Base rates and volatility
- Recent path: about $327 post-earnings low (Jul 23) → $373.51 (Aug 3) → about $361 after the AI shake-up (Aug 5) → about $340 to $345 (Aug 20-21). The trend since early August is down. [TradingKey](https://www.tradingkey.com/analysis/stocks/us-stocks/262070429-alphabet-googl-price-forecast-august-3-2026-recovery-364-resistance-tradingkey), [StockAnalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/googl/history/)
- The 52-week high is reportedly about $404 to $408, probably from around May 2026. Sources conflict on the exact figure.
- My own estimate, not from a source: single-day moves of 4% to 7% suggest realized volatility of roughly 30% to 35% a year. Over 14 trading days that gives a one-standard-deviation move of about ±7% to 8%, or roughly ±$25 to $28 from $345. That implies a ±2 SD band of about $290 to $400. I could not find current implied-volatility data.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Polymarket lists markets for a GOOGL September 2026 month-end close (strikes $290 to $410) and for the week of Sept 11. I only found mirror and aggregator pages and no reliable prices dated before the cutoff. [Predscope](https://predscope.com/event/googl-above-in-september-2026)
- The analyst average 12-month target is reportedly about $420, with a high of $515, from an aggregator of uncertain date and quality. I found no Kalshi or Manifold market for this exact date.

## 6. Upcoming events before Sept 11
- Late August: Nvidia earnings, a major read-through for AI and capex sentiment. I did not confirm the date.
- Early September: the August jobs report. Around Sept 10-11: August CPI/PPI. The Fed meeting (about Sept 15-16) falls after resolution.
- Early to mid September: Alphabet presents at Goldman Sachs Communacopia. [Alphabet IR](https://abc.xyz/investor/news/default.aspx)
- Pending as of Aug 22: Judge Brinkema's ruling on remedies in the ad-tech antitrust case (E.D. Va.). This could come at any time.
- Ongoing: news on the delayed flagship Gemini release, further AI staff departures, Iran and oil headlines, and any change in the buyback or capex.
